doc: n = 196 distinct values: here rank * (256 / 196) is off by one from floor(rank * 256 / 196) at 3 ranks (float rounding of the pre-divided factor). A port must multiply first (rank * 256) then divide, or use integer arithmetic floor(256 rank / n); the case fails the other order. Ranks are integers in float64 arithmetic: byte = floor(rank * 256 / n) with the MEAN rank of equal values; byte output: exact.
